global_barrier.abstention: Explicit candidate abstention remains unscorable/null and permits no target callback for the selected campaign. Missing required reference output/receipt is still INCOMPLETE; completed banks do not waive abstention.

global_barrier.mixed: Both independent bank kinds and every selected candidate condition must complete before any protected target callback or partial E01/E06 score. Full-core completeness cannot mask missing D controls, or vice versa.
global_barrier.predictive: S14/A07 admits all selected candidate slots and every required typed bank with original probability/collection receipts; S19 closes all original pre-target resources. Only one complete global campaign seal permits S15/A08 target access.

metric_bindings.rule: Preserve all exact existing fixed-R1/R0/R2 full-core definitions. These estimands are NOT_SELECTED for D-only; no inactive full-core requirement.
Same full-core information/support and accounted budgets; never treat D-versus-P/I as an equal-input E05 contrast.
metric_bindings.when: A predeclared matched P/I or NUM/NUM_REF comparison exists

metric_bindings.rule: Pair every D candidate with both exact-summary DG/DC controls on the same support. Report balanced loss/accuracy, same weighting/uncertainty and all five windows/arms separately. Never pool into E01 full-core primary.
Interpret a deterministic tagged current/previous admitted report; arithmetic and qualified reasoning rubric remain separate, no prediction edits or new target access.

report_schema.D: Tag all E06 outputs D_PCA8_SUMMARY_V1 and both control family identities. Preserve compressed-representation/no-tools limitations and all individual-person effects.
report_schema.R: Tagged report source/campaign and original selected profiles, missingness, source limitations, uncertainty and costs; no reference outputs or raw targets are editable.
report_schema.inactive: Use NOT_SELECTED with null metric values for unselected E01-E07 conditions; distinguish from missing required control or failed selected condition.
report_schema.mixed: Keep separate full-core and D sections; overall readiness requires both while no unlike-score composite is introduced.

conditions.selection: Freeze selected modes, tool conditions, replicates, information profiles, expected source/support, required bank kinds and resource limits before any benchmark training. Empty mode selection is invalid.

standalone_R.current_R: When R accompanies new predictions, S17 waits for S16's globally sealed tagged report; S17's post-report costs are separate from S19's pre-target closure.
standalone_R.entry: AdmittedPriorReportBundle with exact original selected-mode manifest, tagged report bytes, original closure/status/metric provenance, source/exposure and prior costs.
standalone_R.execution: S01/S09 admit the R policy/source, prior report and budget; S17 interprets it and records InterpretationCostClosure; S20 checks reasoning disposition. Do not reactivate S02-S16/S18/S19 scientific producers or open targets.
standalone_R.incomplete_prior_report: May explicitly discuss an authenticated failed/inconclusive report, but absent numerical results remain null and no new prediction or reference completion is claimed.
